definition: past: was/were · past participle: been — to exist or have a quality
example: I want to be a doctor when I grow up.

definition: past: had · past participle: had — to possess or own
example: They have a small house near the sea.

definition: past: did · past participle: done — to perform an action
example: Please do your homework before dinner.

definition: past: said · past participle: said — to speak words
example: She didn't say anything about the meeting.

definition: past: went · past participle: gone — to move or travel
example: We go to the gym every morning.

definition: past: got · past participle: gotten/got — to obtain or receive
example: I got a letter from my brother yesterday.

definition: past: made · past participle: made — to create or produce
example: He made a cake for her birthday.

definition: past: knew · past participle: known — to have information or be aware
example: I knew the answer to that question.

definition: past: thought · past participle: thought — to use the mind to consider
example: She thought about the problem all night.

definition: past: took · past participle: taken — to grasp or carry
example: He took my umbrella by mistake.

definition: past: saw · past participle: seen — to perceive with the eyes
example: I saw a great film last weekend.

definition: past: came · past participle: come — to move toward a place
example: Can you come to my party on Friday?

definition: past: wanted · past participle: wanted — to desire (regular, but a top verb)
example: They wanted to leave early.

definition: past: gave · past participle: given — to hand something to someone
example: She gave me a useful book.

definition: past: found · past participle: found — to discover or locate
example: I found my keys under the sofa.

definition: past: told · past participle: told — to inform or narrate
example: He told us a funny story.

definition: past: felt · past participle: felt — to experience an emotion or sensation
example: I felt tired after the long trip.

definition: past: became · past participle: become — to start to be something
example: She became a teacher in 2010.

definition: past: left · past participle: left — to go away from a place
example: They left the office at six.

definition: past: put · past participle: put — to place something somewhere
example: Please put the box on the table.

definition: past: meant · past participle: meant — to intend or signify
example: I didn't mean to hurt you.

definition: past: kept · past participle: kept — to retain or continue
example: She kept all his old letters.

definition: past: let · past participle: let — to allow or permit
example: My parents let me stay up late.

definition: past: began · past participle: begun — to start
example: The movie began at eight o'clock.

definition: past: showed · past participle: shown — to let someone see something
example: He showed me his new car.

definition: past: heard · past participle: heard — to perceive sound
example: I heard a strange noise last night.

definition: past: ran · past participle: run — to move quickly on foot
example: She ran to catch the bus.

definition: past: brought · past participle: brought — to carry something to a place
example: Don't forget to bring your passport.

definition: past: wrote · past participle: written — to form letters or words
example: He wrote a letter to his friend.

definition: past: sat · past participle: sat — to rest on a seat
example: We sat by the window during lunch.

definition: past: stood · past participle: stood — to be on one's feet
example: They stood in line for an hour.

definition: past: lost · past participle: lost — to no longer have something
example: I lost my phone at the station.

definition: past: paid · past participle: paid — to give money for something
example: She paid for the dinner.

definition: past: met · past participle: met — to come together with someone
example: I met her at a conference.

definition: past: set · past participle: set — to put or arrange in place
example: He set the alarm for six.

definition: past: spoke · past participle: spoken — to talk or use language
example: She speaks three languages.

definition: past: read · past participle: read — to look at and understand text
example: I read that book last summer.

definition: past: bought · past participle: bought — to get something for money
example: We bought fresh fruit at the market.

definition: past: sent · past participle: sent — to cause something to go somewhere
example: He sent me an email this morning.

definition: past: built · past participle: built — to construct something
example: They built a new bridge over the river.

definition: past: spent · past participle: spent — to use time or money
example: We spent the whole day at the beach.

definition: past: ate · past participle: eaten — to consume food
example: I ate breakfast before leaving.

definition: past: drank · past participle: drunk — to take in liquid
example: She drank a glass of water.

definition: past: drove · past participle: driven — to operate a vehicle
example: He drove to work in the rain.

definition: past: slept · past participle: slept — to rest with eyes closed
example: I slept for nine hours last night.
